verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gemini accepts uploaded spreadsheets and documents for 'answers, summaries, and insights', and it can help with coding and importing code repositories. Nothing documents the assistant actually executing code on user data to produce charts, computed results, or downloadable output files. Analyzing uploaded content and writing code are adjacent capabilities, not a code-execution sandbox, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant write and run code on my data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files
